findings.problem: The example has no conjugated verb; it is a set greeting with no verb at all.
findings.fix: example.es: Esa dama es muy elegante. / example.en: That lady is very elegant.

back.es: la dama = lady (a woman, especially in an elegant or formal sense)

note: The hint matters here because señora is the everyday word for lady, and the hint's "elegant or formal" is what points to dama, so it should stay.
